exclusions.reason: Static image and SVG assets (photos, illustrations, logotypes) are referenced by HTML/CSS but contain no rendered UI logic and are not valid point-and-edit source anchors.
Raw SVG icon source files are static assets; they are not UI source anchors — the icon sheet HTML is the renderable artifact.
Figma Make tooling configuration files are not UI source anchors.
Claude Code harness configuration and permission files contain no rendered UI source.
Git internal objects and metadata are not source files of any kind.
Markdown files are design, brand, product and decision documentation; they contain no rendered UI source.
Product surface documentation files describe intent and contain no rendered UI source.
Decision logs and restructure plans contain no rendered UI source.
Token and link lint scripts are developer tooling; they are not rendered UI source anchors.

generated.explanation: Repository is a self-contained vanilla HTML/CSS/JS design system with no framework or build step; all rendered UI lives in the launcher shell, the token layer, and the prototype folders, making classification unambiguous with only a small number of files to consider.
